headline: Strikes on logistics shift to western Ukraine: Expert names the most vulnerable link
summary: Strikes on logistics facilities in Ukraine increasingly hit western regions, and refrigerated warehouses have proven the most vulnerable, according to Oleksandr Bondarenko of the Investment Programs Bureau.
why: Logistics and cold-storage capacity underpin food supply chains and exports, so damage to warehouses raises costs and disrupts trade.
